2115048985865965959.en_summary: $SOFI Q3: adj. EPS $0.18 vs $0.17 est, sales $1.371B vs $1.256B est, members +35% to 17.1M; raised FY2027 EPS and sales guidance. Shares +9% pre-market.
2115048985865965959.zh_summary: $SOFI第三季：經調整每股盈利0.18美元（預期0.17美元），營收13.71億美元（預期12.56億美元），會員增長35%至1,710萬；上調2027財年每股盈利及營收指引。盤前上漲9%。

2115049195673718808.en_summary: $SOFI says its guidance doesn't require raising additional capital, as existing cash and growing profits should fund expansion through 2027. Author says focus can now shift from dilution risk to how much cash SoFi generates as it scales.
2115049195673718808.zh_summary: $SOFI表示其指引無需額外融資，現有現金及增長中的利潤足以支持至2027年的擴張。作者認為市場焦點可從攤薄風險轉向SoFi擴大規模後能產生多少現金。

ticker_notes.SOFI: 無需額外融資，攤薄風險下降
